correctness.rationale: Final corrected RESULT.md repairs a definite off-by-one centering: for beta>1, urns 1,...,m-1 are all occupied, urn m is asymptotically Bernoulli, higher urns are empty; hence K_beta(t_m)-(m-1) => B_gamma, equivalently K_beta(t_m)-m => B_gamma-1, NOT B_gamma. After this repair, independent Poisson occupancies give exact variance sum; width w_t=beta^-1 L_t^(1/beta-1) and Frullani integral log 2 show diverging variance and Lyapunov CLT for 0<beta<1. At beta=1 logarithmic phase yields integer-valued limits; beta>1 has nondegenerate Bernoulli subsequence. Fixed-sample de-Poissonization not asserted. Reconstructed finite integer-bookkeeping check and analytic proof of tails; finite tests are not the infinite proof.
